title: Release Notes for Safari Technology Preview 257
content:
Safari Technology Preview Release 257 is now available for download for macOS Golden Gate and macOS Tahoe. If you already have Safari Technology Preview installed, you can update it in System Settings under General → Software Update.

This release includes WebKit changes between: 324654@main…326096@main.

Animations

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed content overlapping a running accelerated filter animation (such as a blur) being painted below the animated element. (325784@main) (190763952)
  • Fixed an issue where a view transition kept running with a stale ::view-transition-new() when the new element became hidden by content-visibility: hidden; the transition is now skipped. (325900@main) (191543407)
  • Fixed an issue where a rendering update was not scheduled after changing an animation’s timeline to a ViewTimeline, which could prevent the animation from updating. (325449@main) (191570099)
  • Fixed an issue where backdrop-filter blur did not animate correctly when threaded animations were enabled. (325591@main) (191605067)

CSS

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed ::first-letter and ::first-line to allow only the properties the CSS Pseudo-Elements specification permits, made both pseudo-elements animatable, and fixed getComputedStyle() for them on non-block elements. (325393@main) (100561733)
  • Fixed insertRule() not working when inserting @scope rules. (325468@main) (142005371)
  • Fixed named style container queries on :host not applying to slotted elements. (325470@main) (167244007)
  • Fixed fixed table layout ignoring the border and padding of percentage-width cells. (325373@main) (179489436)
  • Fixed vertical-align: top and vertical-align: bottom on the last child of a nested inline box so that following content is no longer included in its aligned subtree. (324989@main) (189071684)
  • Fixed an ancestor’s overflow clip ignoring corner-shape changes and clipping square corners as rounded. (324753@main) (189340250)
  • Fixed overflow-wrap: anywhere not treating the boundary between adjacent white-space: nowrap inline elements as a soft wrap opportunity. (325882@main) (190264355)
  • Fixed forgiving selector list recovery splitting on commas inside blocks of an invalid selector. (325466@main) (190298284)
  • Fixed the max-content width of a multi-line column flex container to be its widest item rather than the sum of its lines. (324662@main) (190313974)
  • Fixed resolving the definite height of a flex item with an aspect-ratio in a column flexbox. (325691@main) (190464363)
  • Fixed an issue where text in a closed <details> element with a display: grid ::details-content kept its fallback font widths after a web font loaded. (325819@main) (190574679)
  • Fixed a flex container’s intrinsic width growing each time it was computed when it used a percentage gap. (324665@main) (190776762)
  • Fixed a flex-flow: column wrap flex container keeping a stale max-content width after its height changed. (324706@main) (190780038)
  • Fixed a column-flow grid with auto-fill rows keeping a stale max-content width after its height changed. (324711@main) (190784633)
  • Fixed the baseline of an inline-block containing a block with overflow: hidden inside an inline box. (324661@main) (190786587)
  • Fixed out-of-flow boxes in a grid container ignoring the gutters of collapsed auto-fit tracks. (324960@main) (191002910)
  • Fixed an out-of-flow flex item with align-self: last baseline being placed at the cross-start edge instead of the cross-end edge. (324873@main) (191117031)
  • Fixed text-box-trim on inline boxes trimmed to cap, ex or alphabetic being offset in vertical writing modes. (324974@main) (191117213)
  • Fixed flex containers with distributed align-content space leaving the last line up to 1/64 of a pixel short of the end edge. (325040@main) (191118046)
  • Fixed flex items with auto margins on the main axis ending up to 1/64 of a pixel short of the end edge of the flex container. (325109@main) (191118159)
  • Fixed flex items distributed with justify-content space values ending up to 1/64 of a pixel short of the end edge of the flex container. (324975@main) (191118729)
  • Fixed flexible items overflowing the flex container by up to 1/64 of a pixel because each item rounded its share of the free space separately. (324987@main) (191128611)
  • Fixed an issue where the inline content of a fixed-width block could report stale min-content and max-content sizes. (325059@main) (191215004)
  • Fixed an issue where a flex item with max-width could shrink below its max-width while its siblings stayed too wide. (325332@main) (191225991)
  • Fixed text-box-trim incorrectly trimming the line-over side of inline boxes in vertical-lr writing mode when using trim-start. (325139@main) (191239706)
  • Fixed text-box-trim so that trimming at the start propagates through the border and padding of a block container that sets text-box-trim. (325206@main) (191254988)
  • Fixed an issue where the overline of a trimmed inline box with text-box-trim was not drawn at the trimmed edge. (325187@main) (191255274)
  • Fixed a table with min-width and borders or padding overflowing its shrink-to-fit container. (325368@main) (191255444)
  • Fixed min-width and max-width being ignored on MathML elements. (325249@main) (191258079)
  • Fixed the selection highlight on an ellipsis in the first line being sized and colored using the ::first-line style. (325151@main) (191296114)
  • Fixed a stretched image in a narrow flex container not shrinking below its natural width. (325274@main) (191301942)
  • Fixed printing to lay out page content at 96 CSS pixels per inch instead of 90, matching the CSS specification. (325364@main) (191312592)
  • Fixed a min-content or max-content max-width incorrectly capping the minimum width transferred through aspect-ratio. (325240@main) (191330680)
  • Fixed a table’s aspect-ratio not transferring its min-height to its intrinsic width contributions. (325241@main) (191331239)
  • Fixed text-overflow: ellipsis hiding more of the first line than needed when ::first-line sets a larger font size. (325279@main) (191352930)
  • Fixed a multi-column flex item being baseline aligned by the wrong column. (325367@main) (191399721)
  • Fixed line-clamp counting an outside list marker as a line, which clamped list items one line too early. (325385@main) (191419440)
  • Fixed text-overflow not applying to a line-clamp block ellipsis that overflows the line. (325356@main) (191466391)
  • Fixed a table with aspect-ratio being as tall as its aspect ratio makes it plus its rows. (325774@main) (191485863)
  • Fixed conic-gradient() color stops breaking when max() with percentages is used. (325849@main) (191498204)
  • Fixed changing widows or orphans not triggering layout. (325425@main) (191514148)
  • Fixed box-decoration-break: clone not painting a full border-image on each fragment of a split inline. (325426@main) (191514468)
  • Fixed a filter on an overflow: hidden rounded element dropping its border when an ancestor also has overflow: hidden and border-radius. (325901@main) (191519236)
  • Fixed line layout for text inside display: contents elements so the line height of the parent box is used, and the text’s font only stretches the line when that line height is normal, matching Firefox. (325558@main) (191578085)
  • Fixed getComputedStyle() so the font-size value includes text zoom again. (325600@main) (191629138)
  • Fixed text-overflow: ellipsis truncating text that runs opposite to the line direction so that it removes whole user-perceived characters instead of splitting surrogate pairs or grapheme clusters. (325687@main) (191760915)
  • Fixed a line-clamp string block ellipsis being painted horizontally in vertical writing modes. (325821@main) (191873016)
  • Fixed text-combine-upright text so innerText, copy, and accessibility return the combined text instead of U+FFFC. (325946@main) (191972461)
  • Fixed cqi units not updating when the padding of a box-sizing: border-box container changes. (325933@main) (191984223)
  • Fixed an issue where upright text in a monospace font with a vertical writing-mode was measured too narrow, causing incorrect line breaking and line clamping. (325951@main) (192081282)
  • Fixed border-image with a fractional image-set() resolution to compute the correct slices instead of truncating the scale factor. (326068@main) (192132215)

Canvas

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed root font relative units in canvas ctx.font resolving against the canvas element instead of the root element. (325391@main) (184337961)
  • Fixed drawing after reset() if the transform was non-invertible. (329203@main) (191171984)
  • Fixed path after canvas transform becomes non-invertible. (329548@main) (191385929)
  • Fixed clipping in drawImage() when the source rect extends outside the source image. (329650@main) (191456271)
  • Fixed globalCompositeOperation for videos, VideoFrames, and gradient/pattern text. (330047@main) (191742230)
  • Fixed an issue where changing a canvas drop shadow caused content to draw fully opaque instead of respecting globalAlpha. (326029@main) (192039068)
  • Fixed an issue where color font glyphs drawn with a shadow in canvas ignored globalAlpha. (326030@main) (192039073)

Editing

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed a line of text not re-wrapping back onto the previous line after text that caused it to wrap was removed. (325384@main) (191399419)

Forms

New Features

  • Added support for rendering <select multiple size="1"> as a dropdown box on macOS. (325870@main) (191933576)
  • Added preview support, off by default, for the enhanced <select> element with the multiple attribute and list box rendering, and for cloning every selected option into selectedcontent elements. (326015@main) (191940389)

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed <input type="file"> activation so that clicking it is accepted with transient user activation, in the same way as showPicker(), which fixes file pickers failing to open on some sites. (325539@main) (190758283)
  • Fixed a <select> whose form state was restored continuing to show the previously selected option. (324821@main) (190877013)
  • Fixed <selectedcontent> elements of a <select> not all being updated when one of them is moved. (324903@main) (191118813)
  • Fixed the baseline alignment of listbox <select> elements to match vertical-align: text-bottom, consistent with other browsers. (324997@main) (191125523)
  • Fixed an issue where removing the first of two forms sharing an ID fired formAssociatedCallback twice on a form-associated custom element that uses the form attribute. (325660@main) (191734804)
  • Fixed an issue where the scroll position of a scrollable <textarea> jumped on the first edit made below the visible area. (325991@main) (191743391)

Images

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed an issue where an image with object-fit: contain left stale pixels from the previous image when its src changed to a smaller image. (325038@main) (190735629)
  • Fixed image-orientation: none being ignored for same-origin images used as repeating backgrounds or border images, and wrongly honored for cross-origin images. (325213@main) (191363848)

JavaScript

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed function calls that spread too many arguments to consistently throw a RangeError. (325701@main) (191778715)
  • Fixed the Array.prototype.flat() error message to state the correct limit of 2^53 – 1. (326008@main) (191983165)

Media

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed audio files served over HTTP with the application/ogg MIME type failing to play on macOS. (325783@main) (40512703)
  • Fixed VideoDecoder closing with an error when decoding VP8 frames that are not shown, such as alternate reference frames. (324769@main) (138819149)
  • Fixed inline videos sometimes showing a black screen after playing while off-screen. (325855@main) (177400156)
  • Fixed muted autoplaying looping WebM video stopping playback at the second loop boundary. (324855@main) (189626414)
  • Fixed an issue where a media element’s readyState did not return to HAVE_METADATA when seeking to an unbuffered position, which caused playback to stall after scrubbing. (325111@main) (190448987)
  • Fixed an issue where a video briefly shrank within the page after exiting fullscreen by clicking in Safari. (325830@main) (190550400)
  • Fixed captions being overlapped by media controls on sites that use video.js. (325540@main) (190832118)
  • Fixed WebCodecs AudioDecoder to return audio channels in Web Audio channel order. (324993@main) (190905240)
  • Fixed WebCodecs VideoEncoder to reject configurations with a zero bitrate in configure() and isConfigSupported(). (324824@main) (191117654)
  • Fixed an issue where WebVTT STYLE block rules from one text track applied to the cues of other tracks, and corrected their cascade order relative to page styles. (325291@main) (191130060)
  • Fixed MIME sniffing of MPEG-1 MP3 files that computed the wrong frame size. (325857@main) (191819608)

Networking

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed relative tls-certificate-binding Link header references being ignored by resolving them against the response URL. (324709@main) (190868689)
  • Fixed JSON documents and web application manifests to always be decoded as UTF-8. (324849@main) (191010594)
  • Fixed Link response headers on subresources (such as CSS, scripts, and fonts) incorrectly triggering rel=preload and rel=preconnect. Only the main resource now does. (325035@main) (191196085)
  • Fixed removing disk cache data not canceling pending cache writes. (325116@main) (191303133)
  • Fixed beacons sent from pagehide being lost when a page is closed and its process shuts down. (325866@main) (191507608)
  • Fixed Cache‘s match() and matchAll() to queue Reporting API Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy violation reports when a cross-origin opaque response is blocked. (325722@main) (191769480)

Performance

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed sluggish, stuttering scrolling on 60Hz Mac displays. (325736@main) (187724904)
  • Fixed slow rendering and laggy scrolling on pages with many gradients affected by Adaptive Dark Mode color filters. (324781@main) (190976194)
  • Fixed high memory usage from elements with will-change that cover a very large area by limiting the compositing layers created for them. (325986@main) (191108775)

Rendering

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed scrollbars in iframes disappearing after switching to another tab and back. (325789@main) (184796310)
  • Fixed the macOS titlebar becoming translucent when revealed during element fullscreen. (324908@main) (186354937)
  • Fixed a position: sticky element jiggling by a pixel or two while scrolling when it is inside a container with overflow-x: clip. (325813@main) (187137709)
  • Fixed text measured with unicode-bidi: bidi-override reusing cached widths from the same text without the override, which could produce incorrect text widths and layout. (325039@main) (189140386)
  • Fixed text with glyphs extending beyond the line box, such as zalgo text, being painted over during repaint. (325354@main) (190149105)
  • Fixed an issue where the text selection highlight was not visible on some pages, such as github.com. (325357@main) (190440739)
  • Fixed viewport units such as vw and vh growing and squishing page content during two-finger zoom on macOS. (324759@main) (190690179)
  • Fixed text selection highlighting being positioned too close to the top of the line instead of covering the text evenly. (325186@main) (190765820)
  • Fixed the PDF viewer’s heads-up display buttons appearing far too small. (325149@main) (190915095)
  • Fixed glyph overflow being added to the wrong sides of a text box’s ink overflow in vertical and horizontal-bt writing modes. (325776@main) (191485780)
  • Fixed an issue where a fixed-position element kept stale size and position after its ancestor stopped being its containing block, such as when transform, filter, or contain: paint was removed. (325610@main) (191609323)

SVG

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed SVG <a>, <g>, and nested <svg> elements not rendering outline, including the default :focus ring. (325259@main) (97642031)
  • Fixed fragment URLs for SVG documents in object, embed, or iframe incorrectly scrolling the page. (324862@main) (186468177)
  • Fixed SVG filters appearing blurry on high-DPI displays when the SVG is drawn as an image. (325456@main) (188890391)
  • Fixed SVG point parsing to reject values with trailing invalid characters after the point. (325447@main) (190341099)
  • Fixed removing or retargeting an active <animateMotion> leaving its previous target, and the target’s <use> instances, displaced. (325015@main) (191010745)
  • Fixed stale pixels when an animated SVG <img> with object-view-box is partially repainted. (325405@main) (191531146)
  • Fixed SVG text so vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke measures stroke width in the same coordinate system as SVG shapes, relative to the outermost <svg>. (325461@main) (191578423)
  • Fixed SVG fonts to honor the font-variant attribute. (325698@main) (191773904)

Scrolling

New Features

  • Scrolling to the edge of the document on macOS is now animated with a spring animation. (325876@main) (191909106)

Security

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed an issue where a fragment-only (same-document) navigation could trigger a page reload when Enhanced Security is enabled. (325769@main) (191208475)

Web API

New Features

  • Added AudioWorklet.port and AudioWorkletGlobalScope.port, allowing a page and its audio worklet to exchange messages without creating a processor node. (325762@main) (161670776)
  • Added support for the WebAuthn cross-device fallback URL extension. (324658@main) (190635008)

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed window.print() waiting for active XMLHttpRequest requests, such as long-polling, to finish; the print dialog now appears after the load event. (325938@main) (35035119)
  • Fixed events not being dispatched to nodes inside a sandboxed iframe. (325977@main) (88820311)
  • Fixed mouse events on macOS sometimes reaching the page out of order, such as mouseup before mousedown, when using an input method like Baidu. (325795@main) (102126328)
  • Fixed an issue where an AudioWorklet thread kept running after its document stopped, causing out-of-memory errors when creating WebAssembly.Memory after repeated reloads. (325251@main) (108873396)
  • Fixed the duration argument of AudioBufferSourceNode.start() being measured against the AudioContext clock instead of the source data when loop is true. (325805@main) (166168368)
  • Fixed Back navigation skipping a valid session history entry that is still traversable through the Navigation API. (325340@main) (186603812)
  • Fixed element.focus() dispatching focusin but not focus while the page is not focused. (325635@main) (189962933)
  • Fixed a MessageChannel whose ports stay within one page permanently ceasing to deliver messages after the Networking process disconnects. (325343@main) (190069996)
  • Fixed the MouseEvent constructor and initMouseEvent() remapping a button value of -2 to 0. (325341@main) (190182026)
  • Fixed an issue where previously buffered audio was heard when resuming an AudioContext after it was suspended. (325183@main) (190634066)
  • Fixed Cache.put() so it replaces the stored request, not only the response, when overwriting an existing entry. (324795@main) (190659952)
  • Fixed an issue where concurrent CacheStorage operations failed with an error on an origin that had no existing cache data. (324794@main) (190660037)
  • Fixed requestIdleCallback dropping the timeout when the callback was already in the list of runnable idle callbacks. (325318@main) (190685362)
  • Fixed an issue where only the first navigation of an iframe was reported in the parent document’s Resource Timing entries. Every navigation initiated by the parent document is now reported. (325284@main) (191225392)
  • Fixed FileSystemWritableFileStream.close() resolving its promise before the file was committed. (325091@main) (191280663)
  • Fixed File System Access operations reporting success when the operation had not actually completed. (325131@main) (191312739)
  • Fixed navigator.credentials.get() dropping OpenID4VP requests when a page also offered an org-iso-mdoc request; all requests are now presented together. (325322@main) (191358037)
  • Fixed the async clipboard API to UTF-8 decode text blobs it writes. (325398@main) (191377836)
  • Fixed an unreferenced AbortSignal.any() signal being garbage collected while its sources could still abort, which left listeners added with it as their signal option from being removed. (325360@main) (191425913)
  • Fixed cloned documents to keep the base URL of the original document, so relative URLs resolve correctly. (325914@main) (191815349)
  • Fixed an issue where going back during a pending cross-site navigation left the back/forward list on the wrong item. (326047@main) (191848075)
  • Fixed an issue where a dedicated worker started from a blob URL that was revoked immediately got a new opaque origin, which prevented it from reading Blob objects or importing other blob URLs. (325843@main) (191852940)
  • Fixed ReportingObserver reports and their bodies to be plain objects, so they can be structured-cloned and posted, and removed their toJSON() methods. (326027@main) (191919096)
  • Fixed AudioBufferSourceNode so that it fires the ended event when it is started with a null buffer. (325902@main) (192021071)
  • Fixed ReportingObserver invoking its callback with no reports after takeRecords() was called. (326014@main) (192066128)
  • Fixed SubtleCrypto.deriveBits() to enforce the range of its length argument, as the specification requires. (326024@main) (192131498)
  • Fixed XPath so that / evaluated from an attribute node selects the document root instead of the attribute. (326066@main) (192142816)

Web Extensions

New Features

  • Added a warning when a manifest V2 extension defines action without browser_action, or a manifest V3 extension defines browser_action without action. (324852@main) (148339024)
  • Added enum types such as cookies.SameSiteStatus, declarativeNetRequest.ResourceType, extension.ViewType, and menus.ContextType to the browser.* namespaces. (324948@main) (191146181)
  • Added a windowId property to runtime.MessageSender. (325024@main) (191158045)
  • Added support for "message_serialization": "structured_clone" in the extension manifest, so messages sent with runtime.sendMessage() can carry values such as ArrayBuffer and Blob between content scripts and the background page. (325948@main) (191800053)

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed tabs.update() allowing web extensions to navigate a tab to javascript: URLs, or to file: URLs when the extension does not have file access. (325101@main) (114831180)
  • Fixed tabs.connect() also connecting to the opener or opened window of the target tab. (325232@main) (140626378)
  • Fixed declarativeNetRequest modifyHeaders rules rejecting custom header names. (325082@main) (148430468)
  • Fixed dom.openOrClosedShadowRoot returning user-agent shadow roots; it now returns only open or closed shadow roots. (324878@main) (160845916)
  • Fixed Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only incorrectly blocking Safari extension scripts from loading. (324793@main) (168472819)
  • Fixed icon_variants so that an icon block containing unknown properties is ignored entirely instead of having only the unknown properties ignored. (324981@main) (169804881)
  • Fixed runtime.lastError not being exposed to content scripts. (324858@main) (176784505)
  • Fixed action.setIcon() with windowId only taking effect after switching tabs. (324800@main) (177792323)
  • Fixed the generated extension background page to declare UTF-8, so non-ASCII characters in JavaScript source files without a byte order mark are decoded correctly. (325533@main) (181818327)
  • Fixed extension action popups not scrolling to the newly focused element when moving focus with the keyboard. (325064@main) (183935725)
  • Fixed excessive memory use in web extensions by registering each event listener only once and delivering runtime and port messages without keeping a copy per listener. (325757@main) (190248545)
  • Fixed incorrect popup size and positioning for extensions when scrollbar-gutter: stable both is used. (326031@main) (190521334)
  • Fixed the declarativeNetRequest quota check for updateDynamicRules and updateSessionRules counting existing rules twice. (325096@main) (190609107)
  • Fixed background.page to take precedence over background.scripts when both are specified and preferred_environment does not decide. (325001@main) (191041367)
  • Fixed an issue where a manifest icons or default_icon value that was not an object was silently ignored instead of reporting an error. (325022@main) (191169296)
  • Fixed an issue where malformed icon_variants values in a manifest were not validated. (325023@main) (191169365)
  • Fixed an issue where icon_variants selection compared sizes in points instead of pixels, which could choose a smaller icon over a larger one on 2x displays. (325021@main) (191169568)
  • Fixed an issue where an extension action popup clipped its scrollbar when scroll bars were set to always show. (325159@main) (191227048)
  • Fixed action.enable(), action.disable(), and action.isEnabled() to each accept either a tab identifier or a details object with tabId or windowId. (325102@main) (191262757)
  • Fixed alarms.create() to reject alarm names longer than 1024 bytes and new alarms once an extension has 500 alarms. (325100@main) (191263640)
  • Fixed action.getPopup() to return a full extension URL instead of the path as it was given. (325107@main) (191274316)
  • Fixed action.setIcon() and action.setPopup() to reject with an error and leave the action unchanged when given a path to a file that does not exist in the extension. (325104@main) (191291358)
  • Fixed resource paths with a query, fragment, or percent-encoding, such as icons/toolbar.png?v=2#x or my%20icon.png, not being found for web extensions created from in-memory resources. (325504@main) (191294631)
  • Fixed Port.disconnect() firing onDisconnect on the port that called it; it now fires only on the other end of the connection. (325256@main) (191316639)
  • Fixed action.setIcon() to resolve and change nothing when called without a known property, and made options dictionaries optional when all of their properties are optional. (325532@main) (191351377)
  • Fixed declarativeNetRequest redirect rules of equal priority from the same extension that only remove query parameters with queryTransform.removeParams so they all apply instead of only the first. (325510@main) (191496188)
  • Fixed icon_variants to prefer an explicit icon size that is large enough before falling back to an any size icon. (326078@main) (192098547)

Web Inspector

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed the SVG preview in the Sources tab being blank when the SVG references a <symbol> from <defs>. (325289@main) (151300634)
  • Fixed “Pause on next statement” stopping in internal scripts, default class constructors, and at the end of blackboxed scripts instead of in the page’s own code. (325681@main) (187630174)
  • Fixed the debugger forgetting a requested pause at the next statement when the page’s global object is cleared. (325342@main) (189444035)
  • Fixed the Layout panel no longer listing grid and flex containers after the page reloads or navigates. (324756@main) (189971660)
  • Fixed an issue where pausing at the next statement stopped at the end of a script that was blackboxed by URL instead of in the following non-blackboxed code. (324999@main) (191157379)
  • Fixed an issue where a pause at the next statement was dropped when a blackboxed script run from the event loop finished, so the debugger did not stop in the page code that followed. (325189@main) (191215871)
  • Fixed a redirected hidden Network.loadResource request leaving a Network row that never finished. (325649@main) (191410214)
  • Fixed the SVG preview being blank when the SVG was preloaded without the fragment it is later used with. (325369@main) (191434510)
  • Fixed URL breakpoints pausing on loads that are hidden from Web Inspector. (325665@main) (191456032)

WebAssembly

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed incorrect results in WebAssembly code that moves v128 values between stack slots in the baseline compiler. (324957@main) (191050549)
  • Fixed the relaxed SIMD dot product with accumulate instruction (i32x4.relaxed_dot_i8x16_i7x16_add_s) returning a wrong result on ARM64 in some cases. (325501@main) (191511930)
  • Fixed a JavaScript Promise Integration (JSPI) stack scan error that could be thrown on valid WebAssembly programs. (325568@main) (191670691)

WebDriver

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed WebDriver navigation commands so they wait for the navigation they started instead of completing on an unrelated load or before the load event is emitted. (325887@main) (188588971)
  • Fixed WebDriver BiDi session.subscribe to validate the userContexts parameter, so an empty array is now rejected. (325657@main) (190409711)
  • Fixed WebDriver BiDi browsingContext.traverseHistory to navigate to the requested history entry and return the correct errors. (325961@main) (190530418)

WebGL

Resolved Issues

  • Fixed a performance regression where calling invalidateFramebuffer() on a texture that had not been written to caused it to be zero-filled on the CPU every frame. (325013@main) (191073603)
  • Fixed WebGL depthRange() with a near value greater than the far value being ignored after the viewport or framebuffer changed. (325562@main) (191381476)

WebGPU

New Features

  • Added support for dual-source blending in WebGPU. (325793@main) (191687145)

Resolved Issues
